text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: Elevated 5xx/error-rate on prod-us-east inference cluster (model-runner pool 'bert-xxl'). Threshold triggered: 12m high-rate. Severity: P1. Paging aya (oncall).
aya (oncall): I’m on it. seeing spikes in 5xx + request timeouts on gateway -> runner path. Quick check: dashboards?
sam (prod): Confirmed. latency p50 stable, p95 and error-rate up. Affected routes: /v1/generate with long-seq workloads. A handful of customers reporting retries.

maria (sre): Alerting shows correlating OOMs and some segfaults from model-runner pods. Logs show repeated SIGSEGV on inference worker.

nick (eng-runtime): pulling logs now. if it's segfault, could be quant kernel or new fp16 path. any recent rollouts?

deploy-bot: Rollout history: policy-quant-2.1 deployed to prod-us-east at 1769872000 by nick. Canary passed on <10% traffic.

aya (oncall): ok rollbacks might help. But first mitigation: reduce batch sizes and disable auto-batching on the affected pool, and route traffic to fallback smaller model (bert-large) for critical customers. Can someone run the commands?

sam (prod): running routing change to divert 20% -> fallback: `redwood route update --cluster prod-us-east --from model:bert-xxl --to model:bert-large --pct 20`
sam (prod): routing update applied. will monitor 2 mins.

maria (sre): scaling down batch size policy on pool: `rcli pool set --name bert-xxl --max-batch 1 --disable-continuous-batching`
maria (sre): command executed. watchers: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=bert-xxl` shows pods still running but reuse reduced.

nick (eng-runtime): grabbing a failing pod logs: `kubectl logs model-runner-7f8b9 -c runner | tail -n 200`

```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] worker(12) INFO handle_request seq_len=8192
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] worker(12) ERROR attempt allocate 123456789 bytes -> OOM
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] worker(12) FATAL uncaught SIGSEGV at 0x7ffd
stack: libkvcache.so(+0x12f4a)
```

nick (eng-runtime): definitely a memory blowup on long sequences with new kernel. capturing core. `kubectl exec -it model-runner-7f8b9 -- tar cz /var/crash > /tmp/core-7f8b9.tgz` then scp to s3.

aya (oncall): good. Maria, check if autoscaler is evicting/recreating causing churn. We need stability before rollbacks.

maria (sre): autoscaler shows a bunch of evictions at 14:02:15 due to oom. Not enough headroom. Increased buffer by adding 2 spare nodes to the GPU pool: `scale infra-gpu --region us-east --delta 2`

maria (sre): nodes added and pods rescheduled. error-rate dipped slightly after routing to fallback.

customer-ops: we've notified impacted customers on status page with advisory: "Some requests may get 5xx; we have partial mitigations in place."

nick (eng-runtime): proposing immediate rollback of policy-quant-2.1 to 2.0 on prod-us-east. If kernel change introduced a regression, rollback should stop segfaults. Need approval from oncall.

aya (oncall): Approve rollback. execute when traffic stabilized. Maria, coordinate pod restarts and ensure core dumps preserved.

sam (prod): initiating rollback: `deploy rollback --policy policy-quant-2.1 --to policy-quant-2.0 --region prod-us-east --wait`

sam (prod): rollback started. will watch health checks.

deploy-bot: Rollback event accepted. Monitoring health.

aya (oncall): while rollback is in progress, enable fallback routing at 50% for high-SLA customers only. We need to preserve experience for paying customers.

sam (prod): updated route: fallback -> 50% for customers in list. `redwood route update --customer-ids 111,222 --pct 50`

maria (sre): health checks show error-rate dropping from 18% -> 6% after rollback applied to canary nodes, full rollout in progress.

nick (eng-runtime): continuing debug: core dump shows segfault in `quant_kernel_avx2` with invalid pointer on kv-cache reclaim. Suspect race when kv-cache evicted during continuous batching. Short-term mitigation: disable continuous kv-cache reclaim and force kvcache flush on restart. I'll push hotfix to runtime, but we need time to test.

aya (oncall): action list: 1) rollback quant kernel (done), 2) disable continuous-batching (done), 3) scale pool + add spare nodes (done), 4) route critical traffic to fallback (done), 5) collect cores/traces (in progress), 6) eng-runtime to prepare hotfix patch and staged canary.

nick (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR for kvcache sync fix and a defensive NULL-check in reclaim path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5423

nick (eng-runtime): PR tests passing locally; will request a canary build to non-prod first. Do not ship to prod until canary validated.

aya (oncall): agree. For immediate stabilization, keep rollback and routing changes until hotfix validated. Maria, put an incident message on DRI channel and set a 30m war-room at 14:20 UTC.

maria (sre): war room created: https://meet.redwood.com/warroom/1769876543 (14:20 UTC). Incident page updated with timeline and customer impact.

customer-ops: updating status page: "Mitigations in place, rollback applied, partial relief observed. Engineering investigating root cause."

sam (prod): we're seeing p95 latency improve and 5xx trending down. still monitoring.

aya (oncall): handing off to night oncall nick for continued monitoring and follow-up. I'll stay on retainer for the next hour. Please summarize current state for handoff: rollback applied, continuous-batching disabled, 2 spare nodes added, 50% fallback routing for VIP customers, core dumps uploaded s3://redwood-incident-1769876543/cores/, PR opened for hotfix.

nick (eng-runtime): taking handoff. I'll keep alerts muted to critical and run a 1h watch on error-rate and OOM churn. Next steps: validate PR canary tomorrow in staging and plan prod canary with gradual rollout and tracing enabled.

aya (oncall): thanks team. keep the incident thread updated with any regressions. I'll file the postmortem template and assign owners.

maria (sre): adding timeline notes and collecting correlating traces (trace IDs: trace-0a1b2c, trace-0d2e3f).

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 1769877160 — mitigations in place, error-rate reduced below page threshold for 10m.

aya (oncall): closing active pager. Handoff complete. Follow-up owners: nick (runtime) PR & fix, maria (sre) autoscaler tuning, sam (prod) routing policies and customer comms, customer-ops status page.

nick (eng-runtime): will post a short RCA draft after deeper root cause analysis. Expect initial findings in 6-8 hours.

sam (prod): noted. leaving logs and debug dump references in the incident doc.

customer-ops: will follow up with impacted customers with timeline and compensation if required.

aya (oncall): thanks all. good quick coordination. :thumbsup:
